Fit to my head

Auto-fit measures your face width, eyes to mouth, and mouth to chin: look straight at the camera with your mouth closed and press it. To fine-tune by hand, pick Solid, set “Real me showing through” to about half, then adjust until the eye sockets sit on your eyes, the teeth on your mouth and the chin on your chin.
